name: DeFleur Video (Testing)
short_desc: Service: Hermes-operated video edit API with James DeFleur's audio/edit workflow (ASR via Transcriber, alignment, cut evidence, dialogue gate).
author: Humanity Labs; workflow contract informed by Wizard Modules
description: Testing release. HTTP API that Hermes (or any client) drives; no browser UI and no LLM calls. Bundles James DeFleur's original DeFleur Video workflow helpers and runs the audio/edit half: source probe and 48 kHz PCM, preset, preflight, speech-to-text via the separate Transcriber app (install it first), local stable-ts word alignment, sample-exact PCM assembly, per-edge waveform/spectrogram cut evidence and the dialogue audio gate. The older 9:16 preview endpoint still works. Face/crop audit, captions, final 1080x1920 encode, motion graphics and the delivery gate are not built yet. No token needed: keep it on your private network (e.g. Tailscale).

form_fields.label: Transcriber URL
form_fields.hint: Where the Transcriber app answers inside Runtipi. Leave the default if the Transcriber app is installed on this same server.

form_fields.label: Transcriber model
form_fields.hint: Must already be downloaded in the Transcriber app (its startup model).
